title: Withholding a No-Show Penalty on an Air Ticket Fare Brands Booking
content:
A booking whose travellers neither flew nor gave up their seats before the outbound departure is recorded as a no-show, and a penalty is withheld from the value the ticket still carries.

## 1. The situation this governs

The situation is a booking held in one of the Air Ticket Fare Brands whose outbound departure has passed with the seats unused and unreleased. The result governed is the sum withheld from that booking as its no-show penalty, and the effect the traveller sees is a penalty line standing on the booking and a higher net paid total, the money staying with the airline instead of returning to them.

## 2. The write that records it

The withholding is made by the desk. The agent-side tool `withhold_no_show_penalty_8882d2a1` is unlocked and then called; one call posts a single penalty line to the booking's ledger for the stated sum, marks it as the booking's no-show penalty, dates it on today's business date and raises the booking's net paid total by the same sum.

## 3. Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
| --- | --- | --- |
| air_booking_id | the internal reference number of the air booking the penalty is withheld from, read from the traveller's booking record returned by the booking lookup | an identifier |
| customer_id | the traveller reference number the penalty line is recorded against, read from the traveller profile returned by the profile lookup | an identifier |
| penalty_amount_usd | the sum withheld from the booking | USD with exactly 2 decimal places, a positive number, rounded to the nearest cent at the moment it is passed; there is no empty value and no other currency |

## 4. What comes back

A plain-language confirmation line naming the reference of the penalty line that was posted, the sum withheld in USD to two decimal places, and the booking's net paid total after the line landed. The presence of that line reference is what indicates the penalty was recorded; nothing is returned when no line is posted.

## 5. Point of judgement

**What does the traveller see once the call comes back?** The penalty line and the new net paid total on the booking, as soon as the line reference is returned.
